newsitem.title: GREECE: FRAGETIS IS IONIAN BANK'S NEW MANAGING DIRECTOR.
newsitem.headline: FRAGETIS IS IONIAN BANK'S NEW MANAGING DIRECTOR.

text.p: Dimitris Fragetis took over as state Ionian Bank's new managing director replacing outgoing Gerassimos Sapountzoglou, the bank said in a statement.
Fragetis is a graduate of the Athens College and the Athens economics university (former ASOEE). He also holds a graduate degree in economics from the English university of Essex.
Fragetis who speaks English and German had been deputy general manager of ANZ Grindlays Bank since 1993. He has also headed the CORPORATE department and has been a treasurer at the same bank.
Fragetis has also worked in the European coal and steel community relations departments of Halyvourgiki SA and is a member of EASE, it said.
